verified_context: A randomized web experiment found both over-reliance on wrong advice and under-reliance on correct advice during a binary head CT task. Advice was deliberately 80% accurate; no commercial model or patient outcome was evaluated.
visual_idea: A simplified head profile faces a separate observation disc while two offset guidance ribbons diverge around it. The split evokes accepting or rejecting advice without marking either path correct or depicting a generated scan.
